description: Hold a UI target by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates to open a context menu or perform another hold gesture. Set durationMs when the default hold duration is unsuitable. Times out after 320s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref such as @e12. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

selector.description: Selector expression such as id="submit" or label="Sign in". Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

settleQuietMs.description: Settle: quiet window in milliseconds (default 500; 300 on the iOS simulator snapshot bridge). On iOS, a broad replacement of a non-empty screen holds at least 1500ms within timeoutMs.

x.description: Screen x coordinate, with y. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y; use x+y only when no ref or selector is available.

y.description: Screen y coordinate, with x. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

name: longpress
